preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is an integer between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.
Each of the n-1 lines contains exactly two integers representing an edge.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n and int(x) != int(y) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each edge (x, y) connects distinct vertices x and y within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: len(set((int(x), int(y)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()])) == n - 1
preconditions.description: The edges form a tree (no cycles, connected, and exactly n-1 edges).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(dominant_index(i, tree)) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
postconditions.description: For each vertex i (1 ≤ i ≤ n), the output contains the dominant index of vertex i, where the dominant index is the smallest index j such that d_{i,j} is strictly greater than all d_{i,k} for k < j and greater than or equal to all d_{i,k} for k > j.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(d) <= max_depth for d in stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: Each dominant index d in the output is a non-negative integer not exceeding the maximum depth of the tree from vertex 1.
